measured_at.note: All measurements below were taken by me at these SHAs. The committed prior report .scratch/code-release-10-10-v2/reports/25-audit.md was measured at backend 45f8a2e99 (T0) / 66f09164f (T1) and frontend 7469d2789 / 26df21488; two of its live findings are now repaired and one of its clause verdicts is refuted below.

criteria.evidence: REFUTED CLAIM. The committed prior report .scratch/code-release-10-10-v2/reports/25-audit.md states, in its PRD-C030 clause table: 'no `as any` | **MET** | 0 in backend app code, 0 in all 2,128 backend specs, 0 in frontend source. Grepped both repos whole, not just the gate corpora.' That is untrue at head. `grep -rn "as any\b" src/ test/ evals/ --include='*.ts'` in streamlineos-backend at e1fd1d475 returns 162 hits (159 excluding comment lines) in 31 files, EVERY ONE of them a .spec.ts, and every one real code rather than prose — e.g. src/modules/e-sign/__tests__/e-sign-services-tenant-isolation.spec.ts:79,90,100,101,102 (`const mockAudit = { record: jest.fn() } as any;`) x21 in that file alone; src/modules/invoices/invoices-write-tenant-isolation.spec.ts:31,32,33,34 x14; src/modules/rbac/roles-tenant-isolation.spec.ts:63,64,65 x12; src/modules/organization/core/lifecycle/organization-legal-hold.service.spec.ts:86,118,135,154,177 (`fn(tx as any)`). They arrived with the isolation-spec repair lane (commit ac9342531 'test: fix 23 isolation specs that crashed before asserting anything'), and the spec population grew 2,128 -> 2,186 between the report and head. The criterion text carries no application-only scope, so these count. NOW THE CRITERION ITSELF, CLAUSE BY CLAUSE, ALL MEASURED BY ME. CORPUS CHECK FIRST — both check:type-assertions gates are genuinely NON-VACUOUS and I credit them: /tmp/beg-check_type-assertions.log opens '=== application files scanned: 3675 ===' against 5,817 .ts under src/ minus 2,186 specs, and /tmp/feg-check_type-assertions.log opens '=== application files scanned: 5034 ===' against 5,492 files eslint walks; the backend script hard-codes anti-vacuity floors SCAN_FLOOR_FILES = 2000 (src/scripts/check-type-assertions.mjs:47, 'FAIL: scanned only N file(s), below the floor ... The scan is broken, not the tree clean') and CEILING_FLOOR_TOTAL = 1000 (:315). These detectors cannot report clean over an empty corpus. (1) NO `as any` — holds in application code, fails repo-wide. I independently grepped: 0 `as any` in ALL non-spec backend .ts; in the frontend all 12 whole-package hits are inside scripts/check-type-assertions.mjs's own self-test fixtures and header prose plus one English phrase at lib/renderer/layout.ts:42 ('the same shape as any') — a real zero. But 159 real sites live in 31 backend spec files, which the gate declares out of scope ('Specs are outside this gate entirely', src/scripts/assertion-ceiling-ledger.json note). (2) NO `as unknown as T` — FAILS outright. The backend gate's own head output: '=== `as unknown as`: 29 site(s) in 16 file(s) ==='; the frontend's: '7 site(s) in 6 file(s)'. I verified the frontend seven by hand: instrumentation.ts:14, features/party/parties/parties-page.tsx:228 and :328, features/party/parties/party-detail-sheet.tsx:69, features/party/parties/party-form-dialog.tsx:116, feedbucket-widget/src/network-capture.ts:116, hooks/api/hr/employees.ts:340. Repo-wide the backend holds 3,170 `as unknown as` occurrences across src/ test/ evals/, i.e. ~3,141 more inside the spec suite that no rule reaches. (3) UNJUSTIFIED NON-NULL ASSERTIONS — FAILS. 322 backend non-null `!` (gate: 'plain assertions under a zero-growth ceiling: 1183 (861 `as X` + 322 non-null `!`) in 462 file(s)') and 77 frontend ('995 (918 `as X` + 77 non-null `!`) in 509 file(s)'). I read both ledgers: every entry is a bare count of the shape {"as":1,"nonNull":0} with NO justification text of any kind, so 'unjustified' is the default state by construction and no gate measures the criterion's own qualifier. (4) `@ts-ignore` / `@ts-nocheck` (and `@ts-expect-error`) — HOLDS, genuinely and repo-wide. Backend grep across src/ test/ evals/ returns 0/0/0 including all specs; every frontend hit is inside the gate script's own regex table and self-test fixtures, plus one prose mention at instrumentation.ts:6. (5) BROAD INDEX SIGNATURES USED TO BYPASS A CONTRACT — holds by measurement, unenforced by any detector. `[key: string]: any` = 0 and `Record<string, any>` = 0 in BOTH repos' application code; the backend's 776 `Record<string, unknown>` are the safe narrowing form the criterion elsewhere recommends, not a bypass; only 3 `[key: string]: unknown`. No gate in either repo counts index signatures. ALSO CORRECTING THE PRIOR REPORT'S TWO LIVE FINDINGS, BOTH NOW REPAIRED AT HEAD: its headline said 'check:type-assertions (backend) — exit 1' and 'check:spec-typecheck (backend) — exit 2'; GATE-STATUS.tsv records both at 0 and /tmp/beg-check_type-assertions.log ends 'PASS'. F-LIVE-1 is fixed — src/common/workflow/workflow-store.ts:312 now reads `typeof record.correlation_id === "string" ? record.correlation_id : null`, a runtime narrowing, not the cast the report found.
criteria.blocker: The criterion is NOT MET and the prior clause verdict that made it look closest to met is false. Blockers: (a) 29 backend + 7 frontend `as unknown as` sites remain in application code, 12 of them classified by the gate's own ledger as debt rather than seams; (b) the ~3,141 backend spec and 159 backend spec `as any` sites sit outside every rule by design, so the criterion cannot be satisfied without either extending the gates over the spec suite or amending the criterion to scope itself to application code; (c) 399 non-null assertions carry no per-site justification, so 'unjustified' is unmeasurable. To close: replace each `as unknown as` with a Zod parse or a discriminated union (the 7 narrow-me backend + 5 narrow-me frontend sites already name what they owe), give the gates a spec-suite mode or write the scope carve-out into the criterion, and either justify each `!` in the ledger or convert it to a guard.
criteria.clauses_failing: Clause 'no `as any`' HOLDS in application code over real corpora (3,675 backend / 5,034 frontend files scanned, with hard scan floors) but FAILS repo-wide on 159 real sites in 31 backend spec files — and the prior report's claim of '0 in all 2,128 backend specs' is REFUTED. Clause 'no `as unknown as T`' FAILS: 29 backend + 7 frontend application sites, ~3,141 more in backend specs. Clause 'unjustified non-null assertions' FAILS: 322 backend + 77 frontend under a count-only ceiling that records no justification per site. Clause '@ts-ignore / @ts-nocheck' HOLDS repo-wide including specs. Clause 'broad index signatures used to bypass a contract' holds by measurement (0 any-typed index signatures either repo) but has no detector.

criteria.evidence: Five sub-requirements; TWO hold, THREE fail. WHAT HOLDS, and it is real. 'Maintain a zero-growth, NAMED exception ledger' is met and is the strongest artifact in either ticket: streamlineos-backend/src/scripts/assertion-ceiling-ledger.json carries 462 named file entries totalling 1,183 assertions (861 `as X` + 322 non-null `!`), and frontend/scripts/assertion-ceiling-ledger.json carries 509 entries totalling 995 (918 + 77). Its own note states the ratchet contract: 'a per-file ZERO-GROWTH ceiling on plain `as X` and non-null `!` assertions in application code. Seeded at the head count. It may only ever go DOWN: --update-ledger refuses to raise a number, and the gate fails both when a file gains an assertion and when an entry outlives its site.' The gate is non-vacuous by construction — SCAN_FLOOR_FILES = 2000 at src/scripts/check-type-assertions.mjs:47 and CEILING_FLOOR_TOTAL = 1000 at :315 both FAIL rather than pass when the scan or the count collapses ('The scan is broken, not the tree clean'). Both gates exit 0 at head over 3,675 and 5,034 application files respectively. 'Local' also holds: every site is expression-level, and `@ts-nocheck` = 0 repo-wide so there is no file- or block-level suppression anywhere. WHAT FAILS. (a) 'Permit a type assertion ONLY at a proven external/framework seam' — FAILS, on the gate's own accounting. The double-cast ledger classifies entries by a `seam` field with exactly two values: I counted 33 `external` and 6 `narrow-me` in the backend script, 13 `external` and 4 `narrow-me` in the frontend script; src/scripts/check-type-assertions.mjs:134 annotates that second class '-- narrow-me: ours, knowable, and owed a Zod parse --'. The gates say so in their head output: backend '=== ledger: 22 at a proven external seam, 7 owed a Zod parse ===' and frontend '=== ledger: 2 at a proven external seam, 5 owed a narrowing ===' — so 12 of the 36 application double casts are self-declared debt, not seams. Worse, the 1,183 backend + 995 frontend rule-4 plain assertions carry NO seam classification at all, so 2,178 of the criterion's subject population have never been tested against 'proven external/framework seam'. (b) 'Documented with the invariant' — FAILS for the large majority. The 56 double-cast entries do each carry a written prose `invariant` (I read two in full, e.g. src/scripts/benchmark-access-service.ts and check-declaration-column-drift.ts), which is good. But all 971 rule-4 ledger entries across both repos are bare counts of the form {"as":1,"nonNull":0} — for example src/common/async/bounded-map.ts, src/common/auth/jwt-keyring.service.ts, src/common/auth/record-route-classification.ts, and frontend app/(authenticated)/accounting/opening-balances/page.tsx — with no invariant, no seam and no reason. (c) 'Covered by a negative/runtime contract test' — FAILS, and structurally. I regex-scanned the serialized entries of both rule-4 ledgers for any mention of a spec or test: ZERO of 462 backend entries and ZERO of 509 frontend entries name one. Of the 39 backend double-cast entries only ONE mentions a spec/test anywhere in its invariant text. There is no `test:` field in the entry shape and no self-test asserts the presence of one, so the clause cannot be enforced even in principle as the ledgers are structured today.
criteria.blocker: The ledger half of the criterion is built and working; the permission half is not. Three concrete blockers: (1) 12 application double casts are labelled `narrow-me` by the ledger's own author, meaning the gate agrees they are NOT at a proven external seam — they need the Zod parse they are recorded as owing; (2) 2,178 rule-4 plain assertions have no seam classification and no invariant, so nothing distinguishes a framework seam from ordinary debt in that population; (3) no ledger entry in either repo carries a test reference and the entry shape has no field for one, so 'covered by a negative/runtime contract test' is unenforceable as built. To close: add a required `test:` field (or an assertion in the self-test that each entry names a spec) and populate it; classify the rule-4 population by seam and write an invariant per entry, or drive it down to the sites that genuinely need one; and clear the 12 narrow-me sites.
criteria.clauses_failing: Sub-requirement 'maintain a zero-growth, named exception ledger' HOLDS — 462 + 509 named per-file entries, --update-ledger refuses to raise a count, the gate fails on shrinkage as well as growth, and hard scan floors (2,000 files / 1,000 assertions) make a vacuous pass impossible. Sub-requirement 'local' HOLDS — all sites expression-level, @ts-nocheck = 0. Sub-requirement 'only at a proven external/framework seam' FAILS — 6 backend + 4 frontend ledger entries (7 + 5 sites) are seam:"narrow-me", which the script itself defines as 'ours, knowable, and owed a Zod parse', and 2,178 rule-4 assertions carry no seam at all. Sub-requirement 'documented with the invariant' FAILS for 971 of 1,027 ledger entries, which are bare {"as":N,"nonNull":M} counts. Sub-requirement 'covered by a negative/runtime contract test' FAILS — 0 of 462 backend and 0 of 509 frontend rule-4 entries name a test, only 1 of 39 backend double-cast entries does, and the entry shape has no field for one.
